questions.title: Balanced Brackets
questions.prompt: Return True if every opening bracket in text is closed by the correct bracket in the correct order. Ignore non-bracket characters.
questions.hint: Push opening brackets; for a closing bracket, check the top of the stack.

questions.title: Next Greater Value
questions.prompt: For each value in nums, return the first later value that is strictly greater. Use -1 if none exists.
questions.hint: Keep a decreasing stack of indices whose answer has not been found yet.

questions.title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
questions.prompt: Given intervals [start, end], merge every pair that overlaps and return the merged intervals sorted by start.
questions.hint: Sort by start, then compare each interval with the last merged interval.

questions.title: Minimum Meeting Rooms
questions.prompt: Given meeting intervals [start, end], return the minimum number of rooms needed so that all meetings can run without overlap. A meeting ending at time t frees its room for another starting at t.
questions.hint: Sort all start times and end times separately, then sweep through them.

questions.title: Spiral Matrix Read
questions.prompt: Return all values of a rectangular matrix in clockwise spiral order, starting at the top-left corner.
questions.hint: Maintain top, bottom, left, and right boundaries and shrink them after each side.
